definitions.explanation: A violent weather disturbance with strong winds and often rain or snow.
A period of intense trouble or activity (figurative).

examples.english: A storm seems to be coming.

examples.japanese: {嵐|あらし}の{前|まえ}の{静|しず}けさ。
{嵐|あらし}で{木|き}が{何本|なんぼん}も{倒|たお}れた。
examples.english: Several trees fell over in the storm.

examples.japanese: {拍手|はくしゅ}の{嵐|あらし}が{起|お}きた。
examples.english: A storm of applause broke out.

examples.japanese: {批判|ひはん}の{嵐|あらし}にさらされた。
examples.english: They were exposed to a storm of criticism.

examples.japanese: {人生|じんせい}の{嵐|あらし}を{乗|の}り{越|こ}えてきた。
examples.english: I have weathered the storms of life.

notes:
{嵐|あらし} means storm, both literally and figuratively.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {嵐|あらし}が{来|く}る (a storm is coming)
- {嵐|あらし}が{過|す}ぎる (the storm passes)
- {嵐|あらし}の{前|まえ}の{静|しず}けさ (calm before the storm)
- {拍手|はくしゅ}の{嵐|あらし} (storm of applause)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {台風|たいふう}: typhoon (specific type)
- {嵐|あらし}: storm (general)
- {暴風雨|ぼうふうう}: windstorm with rain (technical)
